issues.sentence: The repo gives one-line runs for llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio and Docker Model Runner.
issues.problem: Unsloth page gives one-line commands for llama.cpp, Ollama and Docker Model Runner; LM Studio appears only as a listed app with no command.
issues.replacement: The repo gives one-line runs for llama.cpp, Ollama and Docker Model Runner, and also lists LM Studio among its local apps.

issues.sentence: Its own card says it is materially below frontier capabilities.
issues.problem: Overgeneralised: the card says loss-of-control testing (agentic capability, strategic deception, sabotage) found the model materially below frontier capabilities, not that it is below frontier overall.
issues.replacement: Its own card says safety testing for agentic capability, strategic deception and sabotage found it materially below frontier capabilities.
